description: This file is a shell script intended to execute a series of automated tests for Git functionalities related to fetch and push operations, including various configurations, hooks, refspecs, and edge cases.

methods.name: mk_empty
methods.description: Initializes an empty repository with a specified name, setting up hooks and configuration to deny the current branch.

methods.name: mk_test
methods.description: Sets up a test repository with initial commits and references, and verifies the push and ref updates.

methods.name: mk_test_with_hooks
methods.description: Creates a test repository and installs hooks to verify hook invocation during push operations.

methods.name: mk_child
methods.description: Clones an existing repository into a new directory.

methods.name: check_push_result
methods.description: Checks that the specified refs in the repository match expected commit SHAs.

methods.name: grep_wrote
methods.description: Searches a file (trace output) for pack write events with a specified number of objects written.

methods.name: tag_type_description
methods.description: Descriptive label for the type of tag being tested (lightweight or annotated).

methods.name: tag_args
methods.description: Arguments used for force updating tags during push tests.

methods.name: test_force_push_tag
methods.description: Function testing the behavior of force-pushing tags, including tags' overwriting rules.

methods.name: test_force_fetch_tag
methods.description: Function testing the behavior of force-fetching tags, ensuring existing tags are not overwritten without --force.
